sentences.text: On 14 August 2026 the checkout service was unavailable for 47 minutes, from 13:02 to 13:49 UTC.
During that time customers could browse the store and fill their baskets, but every attempt to pay failed with a timeout.
The outage was caused by a configuration change to the payments database connection pool, and it was made worse by client retries and by an alert that reached nobody.
Timeline
At 13:02 UTC a routine configuration change was deployed to the payments service.
The change was meant to lower the idle timeout of database connections, but it also reduced the maximum size of the connection pool for payments-db from 200 to 20.
Lunchtime traffic in Europe was close to its daily peak, and within two minutes requests were queueing for a free connection.
The first alert, for payment latency above five seconds, fired at 13:09.
